sections.title: Six ways we can help.
sections.body:
Each engagement is scoped in writing before work starts.

Marketing sites: A clear home for your business. Built to help the right people understand what you do and take the next step.
Landing pages: One page with one clear purpose. Give your next campaign a focused place to turn interest into enquiries.
Website redesign: Keep what works and fix what gets in the way. We simplify your content and rebuild around the actions your visitors need.
Speed audits: Find out what is slowing your site down. Get a practical report with fixes ordered by their likely impact.
Hosting and care plans: Keep your site useful after launch. Choose a defined scope for updates, checks, and ongoing maintenance.
Design systems: Make the next page easier to build. A small, documented set of reusable components keeps your website consistent.

sections.title: The same four steps, in more detail.
sections.body:
Every project runs through the same sequence, whatever its size.

Brief: We agree on your audience, pages, content, and the one action your website needs to support. You get a written scope before design starts.
Design: We establish the visual direction and review the core page layouts with you before any template is written.
Build: We build reusable components, optimize every asset against a page-weight budget, and check mobile layouts and keyboard access as we go.
Launch: After your approval we verify the forms and the speed scores on the real host, then hand over the source and a short guide.

sections.title: Six questions we are asked most.
sections.body:
How long does a website take?: A focused landing page typically takes two to three weeks. A five-page site is usually three to five weeks after content and scope are agreed. These are sample timelines, not a delivery guarantee.
What do you need from us?: Your goals, existing brand assets, and a first draft of your content. We start with a short brief and identify any gaps before design begins.
Can you improve our existing website?: Yes. We can start with a speed and content review, then recommend a focused update or a rebuild based on what we find.
Will we be able to edit the site?: Content is stored in plain text and structured data files. This sample project has no CMS; an editing workflow would be agreed before a real build.
What happens after launch?: You receive the site source and a handover guide. Hosting, maintenance, and future updates are separately scoped so responsibilities stay clear.
Do you guarantee a perfect speed score?: No. We build against a small performance budget and test the result. The hosting environment, content, and later changes can affect scores.
